transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Wednesday, August 5. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 'A rebirth for us': Passengers recall chaos after Air India flight hits turbulence. An Air India flight from Phuket to Delhi encountered severe turbulence on Tuesday morning. The aircraft briefly lost altitude, causing injuries to 17 passengers and crew members. One cabin crew member sustained severe injuries, while others had minor wounds. Passengers described the terrifying ordeal, with some being thrown from their seats. Over 30 operatives killed by 'Indian agents' since 2020: LeT commander. Rizwan Hanif, a commander affiliated with Lashkar-e-Taiba, has alleged that Indian agents have systematically killed more than thirty individuals in different Pakistani locations since 2020. He characterized these murders as acts of religious persecution and rejected the authority of foreign entities. This statement comes amid heightened rhetoric from Pakistan's military, and experts suggest it serves as a strategic narrative amidst rising tensions. Pakistan boxer Qudratullah 'goes missing' in Glasgow after CWG campaign. Pakistani boxer Qudratullah reportedly went missing in Glasgow hours before the national team's departure, with his passport and return ticket remaining with the team manager. Pakistan finished the Commonwealth Games with just one medal, a bronze for Fatima Zahra. Her historic achievement made her the first Pakistani female boxer to win a CWG medal, while Arshad Nadeem missed out. Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding. The Primary School, a tuition-free institution, will close in June after a decade of operation. This school provided education, healthcare, and family support to low-income children. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative will not continue funding beyond the upcoming academic year. Academic results remained below state averages, prompting the board's decision. Government may allow fees on UPI payment above rupees 2k. The government may allow a small charge on UPI payments exceeding two thousand rupees. This levy would apply to transactions made to businesses and not individuals. Official estimates suggest this change will impact only five percent of all UPI transactions. Most daily purchases like groceries and taxi fares will remain unaffected by this potential fee. Day after PK's poll win, PM Modi talks to Nabin, meets Nitish. During a recent NDA meeting, government officials emphasized the importance of economic growth and the creation of jobs. The event also saw discussions surrounding India's evolving sports landscape. Prime Minister Modi and Amit Shah were present, and a humorous exchange between Modi and Nitin Nabin generated buzz among the MPs. Subsequently, Modi held discussions with former Bihar CM Nitish Kumar and his JDU associates. Government to grill Meta brass on child abuse, AI content. In an important meeting scheduled for this week, government officials will confront Meta executives regarding pressing issues. The discussions will center around the presence of child sexual abuse material, the rise of AI-created content, and the measures in place for takedowns involving notable personalities. Compliance with local laws and the efficiency of Meta's content moderation efforts, particularly in monitoring synthetic content, are also poised to be key topics of concern. US Congressman warns FCRA Bill could affect India-US ties. A US lawmaker on Tuesday criticised the amendments proposed to India's foreign funding law, alleging that they could allow the government to take over churches and religious charities and warning that the issue could affect India Illinois farmhouse becomes final training ground for 100 firefighters. A four-generation family farmhouse in Illinois was given a meaningful final purpose before being demolished. The Kestel family donated the vacant house to the New Lenox Fire Protection District, where nearly 100 firefighters trained in realistic live-fire rescue and firefighting exercises over three days. Although watching the home burn was emotional, the family said knowing it helped firefighters gain life-saving experience made its final farewell a fitting tribute to their family's legacy of community service. SIAM says corrosion of vehicle parts due to high chloride presence in fuel. NEW DELHI: Auto industry body SIAM flagged concerns over "high chloride" presence and moisture content in fuel resulting in a "huge increase" in issues related to vehicle parts and replacements, including fuel pumps, fuel injectors and EGR valve. Over half of infected Caribbean corals resisted widespread bleaching. In the Caribbean, researchers are exploring the use of predatory bacteria as a means to combat coral diseases. Laboratory tests have demonstrated that these microscopic bacteria can successfully eliminate harmful Vibrio bacteria while preserving the coral's vital microbiome. This promising method provides a focused mechanism to defend corals against disease. However, additional field trials are necessary for its application in conservation efforts. US may raise H-1B, L-1 visa fees for large employers under DHS proposal. The US government plans to expand an additional visa fee. This fee currently applies to certain large employers filing H-1B and L-1 petitions. The planned change will extend this charge to visa extension requests. Qualifying employers with over fifty employees and a majority in H-1B or L-1 status will be affected.

transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Oil Extends Two-Day Drop on Signs of Progress Toward Hormuz Deal. Oil fell for a third day on optimism a deal can be reached that would reopen the Strait of Hormuz, freeing up supply trapped in the Persian Gulf. CBOT grains, soybeans fall as oil drops on Iran hopes. GLOBAL-GRAINS/ (UPDATE 2):GRAINS-CBOT grains, soybeans fall as oil drops on Iran hopes Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold jumps $61, silver tops $60 on US-Iran de-escalation hopes. Gold and silver prices rose on August 4, driven by easing US-Iran tensions and lower crude oil prices. Gold futures increased by $61 to $4,151 while silver prices climbed $2.35 to $60.24, amid hopes for a diplomatic breakthrough regarding the Strait of Hormuz. Palantir climbs 27 percent on 'otherworldly' AI demand; Karp tells shareholders business has 'Marxist' values. Palantir Technologies' shares surged after raising its financial outlook, expecting up to $4.91 billion in adjusted income driven by strong AI demand. The company is also projecting sales of up to $8.16 billion, exceeding analyst estimates, despite challenges in European markets. SpaceX faces its first earnings test after a turbulent IPO debut; expert says, 'have very little confidence'. SpaceX's first earnings release following its record initial public offering is one of the most anticipated reports of the summer for traders on Wall Street and beyond. Whether it'll give investors a reason to buy the sinking stock is another matter. Crude oil reverses gains, drops 5 percent on renewed Middle East peace hopes; Brent falls below $80. Crude oil prices fell sharply as optimism grew for a peace deal in the Middle East. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent indicated talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz were progressing, easing supply disruption fears. Brent crude dropped 5 percent to $79.5 per barrel amid fluctuating market conditions. Cracks in plane: Air India's scary Phuket-Delhi flight. Air India flight AI2379, traveling from Phuket to Delhi, faced unexpected turbulence that led to minor injuries for twelve individuals, including both passengers and crew. Sebi asks brokers to boost retail participation after auction debut. Sebi has asked brokers to boost retail participation in the new closing auction session after sharp differences in Nifty and Sensex moves. Market participants now fear thin liquidity in BSE's auction could trigger volatility during Thursday's weekly Sensex options expiry. Reits, InvITs may tap overseas investors via depository receipts. Sebi's proposal seeks to broaden funding options and deepen foreign participation in listed investment trusts. US, Canada cereal warning: Check this for your heart. Millions of people in the US and Canada eat cereal for breakfast, but experts say the choice may matter for heart health. Ardee Industries raises rupees 128 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO launch on Wednesday. Ardee Industries raised rupees 127.75 crore from anchor investors before its IPO on August 5, 2026. The company plans to raise rupees 426 crore, utilizing funds for working capital, debt repayment, and corporate purposes. The price band is set at rupees 50-53 per share. Government unveils tax overhaul to woo global investors. A new bill aims to attract foreign investment and support key industries. Institutional investors over subscribe LIC OFS, bid rupees 36,400 crore, retail offer in 6.5 percent stake sale begins tomorrow. Institutional investors have over-subscribed the government's 6.5 percent share sale of LIC by 3.32 times of its base size, bidding rupees 36,400 crore. The OFS opens for retail investors tomorrow, on 5 August, at floor price of rupees 382/share. Gen Z set to unlock India's rupees 315 lakh crore gold. India's gold market is poised for transformation driven by digitally savvy Gen Z consumers. Nykaa Q1 Results: Net profit surges over threefold to rupees 80 crore on strong beauty demand. FSN E-Commerce Ventures, Nykaa's parent, reported a 226 percent YoY increase in profit to rupees 80 crore for the June quarter, driven by rising sales and improved margins. Revenue rose 29 percent YoY to rupees 2,782 crore, led by strong demand in skincare and makeup. Trump's H-1B plan may make visa extensions costly. The Trump administration is preparing to expand an existing fee on H-1B and L-1 visas by applying it to extension petitions, not just new applications and job changes. Closing Auction Session debuts successfully; BSE, NSE report strong participation. Indian stock markets implemented an auction-based closing price mechanism on Monday, enhancing price discovery. The BSE reported strong participation from over 400 trading members, while the NSE noted 515 members engaged, despite a spike in indices being labeled an aberration. Kalyan Jewellers Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 32 percent YoY to rupees 349 crore; margins contract. Kalyan Jewellers reported a net profit of rupees 348 crore for the June quarter, a 32 percent YoY increase. However, it declined sequentially from rupees 409 crore. Revenue rose 46 percent YoY to rupees 10,589 crore, but fell 3 percent QoQ, with lower contribution from studded jewellery. Your car may soon talk to others and save lives. India plans to mandate vehicle-to-vehicle communication technology for new vehicles. Bharti Airtel beats Q1 revenue estimates as premium users drive growth. Bharti Airtel reported a consolidated net profit of rupees 8,167 crore for Q1FY27, a 37.3 percent YoY increase, announced on August 04. However, net profit declined 11.5 percent compared to rupees 7,325 crore in Q4FY26. Iran war drains US long-range missile arsenal. Bharti Airtel announced its Q1FY27 earnings, reporting a 37 percent rise in net profit to rupees 8,167 crore and an 18.3 percent increase in revenue to rupees 58,539 crore, compared to the previous year. US plans polysilicon tariffs to counter China. The Trump administration plans price floors and tariffs on polysilicon imports.
